standard_states.details: All nine standard states are present with the expected used-frame counts and readable, state-correct motion.

jumping_trajectory.details: The five-frame loop reads as crouch, rise, feet-tucked apex, descent, and landing without a shadow, impact effect, or trajectory reversal.

motion_previews.details: Idle is visibly animated; directional running faces the correct way with alternating gait; waving, failed, waiting, active-running, and review remain distinct and loop cleanly.

direction_loop.details: All four cardinals are unmistakable, all 16 poses form a coherent clockwise loop, and the neutral pose is distinct from every direction cell.

scale_baseline_and_cropping.details: Body scale and baseline remain practical and stable; no used cell is cropped, overlaps a slot, floats, or shows a conspicuous registration pop.

transparency_and_artifacts.details: The cleaned final sheet has transparent unused cells, no visible chroma panels, interior holes, seams, detached effects, shadows, guide marks, or stray fragments.
